properties.description: Built 2026-10-20. Items 1, 4, 5 and 6 of the natural-deduction requirement: cases_exhaustive may name a supposition, read as assumed and drawn as an assumed premise, so the →I discharging it holds; a premise named twice is one PREMISE_OF edge with uses: 2; Inference.establishes (entailment ⊨ / derivability ⊢); Inference.conclusion_form (conjunction / biconditional) and a what-if row's `parts`, saying which part stands — dropping RAA on the logic rung leaves De Morgan's ¬(A∧B) ↔ ¬A∨¬B unsupported with its backward direction standing.
properties.name: Natural deduction records its forms: an assumed disjunction as a case split's exhaustiveness, a premise used twice, entailment or derivability, and a conclusion made of parts
